sentences.s: Visit any antiques store and you'll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-1965 World's Fair, the ephemera of history.

components.中文翻译: 照片、信件、一本详细介绍1964—1965年世界博览会辛克莱恐龙展的小册子，这些历史的零碎遗存

sentences.zh: 走进任何一家古董店，你都会遇到来自过去的器物：照片、信件、一本详细介绍1964—1965年世界博览会辛克莱恐龙展的小册子，这些都是历史的零碎遗存。

sentences.s: Yet these objects aren't truly ephemeral, because they're still here, decades, even centuries later. Why?

trunk.主干翻译: 这些物品并非真正转瞬即逝。

sentences.s: Because they're tangible.

components.中文翻译: 因为它们是有形的。

sentences.zh: 因为它们是有形可触的。

sentences.s: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation?

trunk.主干翻译: 你是否思考过无形格式的生命周期？

components.原文: digital information

components.中文翻译: 鉴于那些制造这些器物的人很少为它们的长期保存做出安排
components.说明: given that引导状语从句，表示前提/原因条件

sentences.s: For millennia, we’ve known what we’ve known due to artifacts that have survived, often despite their original creators’ neglect.

trunk.主干翻译: 我们之所以知道我们所知道的东西。

components.原文: what we’ve known
components.中文翻译: 我们所知道的东西
components.说明: what引导宾语从句作know的宾语

components.原文: that have survived, often despite their original creators’ neglect
components.中文翻译: 留存下来的、往往是不顾其原创者忽视而幸存的
components.说明: that引导定语从句修饰artifacts

sentences.zh: 几千年来，我们之所以知道我们所知道的一切，是得益于那些留存下来的器物——它们往往是在原创者的忽视之下幸存下来的。

sentences.s: The thing itself is the medium that delivers the information.

trunk.主干翻译: 物品本身就是媒介。

sentences.zh: 物品本身就是传递信息的媒介。

sentences.s: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.

components.中文翻译: 在创造之时

components.中文翻译: 传记作家、历史学家和小说家

components.中文翻译: 传记作家、历史学家和小说家所依赖的

sentences.zh: 在创造之时，并无人刻意尝试加以保存，然而模拟材料却有机会幸存下来，并充当传记作家、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。

sentences.s: Libraries and archives have traditionally shouldered the responsibility of organization, preservation, and access to information.

trunk.主干翻译: 图书馆和档案馆一直肩负着责任。

components.原文: Libraries and archives
components.中文翻译: 图书馆和档案馆
components.说明: 两个名词并列作主语

components.原文: organization, preservation, and access to information
components.中文翻译: 对信息的组织、保存与获取
components.说明: 三个名词并列作of的宾语，限定responsibility的内容

sentences.zh: 图书馆和档案馆历来肩负着组织、保存信息以及提供信息获取途径的责任。

sentences.s: One of S.R.Ranganathan’s foundational Laws of Library Science is “Save the time of the reader.” Thus, librarians digitize the tangible so that researchers the world over can quickly search and access their holdings.

trunk.宾语或表语: "Save the time of the reader" / the tangible
trunk.主干翻译: 其中一条法则是“节省读者的时间”；因此图书馆员将有形之物数字化。

components.原文: Save the time of the reader
components.中文翻译: 节省读者的时间

components.原文: so that researchers the world over can quickly search and access their holdings
components.中文翻译: 以便世界各地的研究者能迅速检索并获取其馆藏
components.说明: so that引导目的状语从句

components.中文翻译: 检索并获取其馆藏

sentences.zh: S.R.阮冈纳赞图书馆学基本法则之一是“节省读者的时间”。因此，图书馆员将有形之物数字化，以便世界各地的研究者能够迅速检索并获取馆藏。

sentences.s: The result is an embarrassment of historical riches, which brings its own needle-and-haystack problems.

components.原文: which brings its own needle-and-haystack problems
components.中文翻译: 这又带来了大海捞针般的难题
components.说明: which引导非限定性定语从句，指代前面整个情况/embarrassment

sentences.zh: 其结果是历史财富多得令人应接不暇，而这又带来了大海捞针般的难题。

sentences.s: Librarians’ selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cellphone and saying, “it's all in here” as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today.

trunk.主干翻译: 图书馆员无私的奉献可能对我们不利。

components.原文: when users point to universality of access by holding up a cellphone and saying, “it's all in here” as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today
components.中文翻译: 当用户举起手机、说“一切都在这里面”以此作为图书馆对今日研究者不那么重要的证据，来指出获取的普遍性时
components.说明: when引导时间状语从句

components.中文翻译: 举起手机并说“一切都在这里面”
components.说明: by后两个动名词holding与saying并列，作方式状语

components.中文翻译: 一切都在这里面
components.说明: 引语作saying的宾语

components.中文翻译: 图书馆对今天的研究者不那么重要
components.说明: that引导同位语从句，说明evidence的内容

sentences.zh: 当用户举起手机、说“一切都在这里面”，以此作为图书馆对今日研究者不再那么重要的证据来论证获取的普遍性时，图书馆员无私的奉献反而可能对我们不利。

sentences.s: Yet how was that universality of access made possible and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained?

trunk.主干翻译: 那种普遍可及性是如何成为可能的。

components.原文: and, perhaps more importantly, how is it maintained?
components.修饰对象: Yet how was that universality of access made possible
components.中文翻译: 而且，也许更重要的是，它又是如何得以维持的？
components.说明: and 连接的并列疑问分句，其中 perhaps more importantly 为插入语，how is it maintained 为倒装疑问句。

sentences.zh: 然而，那种普遍可及性当初是如何成为可能的，而且，也许更重要的是，它又是如何得以维持的？

sentences.s: Who curates what is preserved?

components.原文: what is preserved
components.中文翻译: 哪些内容被保存下来

sentences.zh: 由谁来甄选并管理哪些内容得以保存下来呢？

sentences.s: When it comes to born-digital information, the terrifying answer can be: if not librarians and archivists, then no one.

trunk.宾语或表语: if not librarians and archivists, then no one
trunk.主干翻译: 那个可怕的答案可能是：若不是图书馆员和档案管理员，就没有人。

components.原文: When it comes to born-digital information
components.中文翻译: 当谈及原生数字信息时
components.说明: when it comes to为固定句式引导条件/话题状语从句

components.原文: if not librarians and archivists
components.中文翻译: 如果不是图书馆员和档案管理员（来做）

components.原文: if not librarians and archivists, then no one
components.中文翻译: 若不是图书馆员和档案管理员，那就没有人
components.说明: if...then...构成的省略句整体作be的表语

sentences.s: Digital information requires a great deal more care than analog.

trunk.宾语或表语: a great deal more care than analog

components.原文: than analog
components.中文翻译: 比模拟（信息）

sentences.s: Even when a digital object is preserved, it may only be the carrier that's saved, not the information itself.

components.原文: Even when a digital object is preserved
components.中文翻译: 即使一个数字对象被保存下来
components.说明: even when引导让步性时间状语从句

components.原文: that's saved
components.中文翻译: 被保存下来的

components.原文: not the information itself
components.中文翻译: 而非信息本身

components.原文: itself
components.中文翻译: 本身
components.说明: 反身代词itself作同位语强调information

sentences.zh: 即便一个数字对象被保存下来，被保存的也可能仅仅是载体，而非信息本身。

components.中文翻译: 随着技术进步、某种格式过时

components.原文: technology advances and a format becomes obsolete

sentences.zh: 你是否曾无助地盯着一张ZIP磁盘，心里想着：我究竟怎样才能把里面的文件取出来呢？

trunk.宾语或表语: what keeps historians up at night

components.原文: Without constant migration of digital assets
components.中文翻译: 如果没有对数字资产持续不断的迁移
components.说明: without引导的介词短语作条件状语

components.原文: what keeps historians up at night
components.中文翻译: 让历史学家彻夜难眠的东西

components.原文: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog
components.中文翻译: 一份在数字取代模拟时戛然而止的历史记录

components.原文: that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog
components.中文翻译: 在数字取代模拟时戛然而止的

components.原文: when digital replaces analog

components.说明: when引导时间状语从句，修饰定语从句中的stops

sentences.zh: 如果没有对数字资产持续不断的迁移，一个关于可预见未来的噩梦正是令历史学家彻夜难眠的事：一份在数字取代模拟之时戛然而止的历史记录。

sentences.s: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I’d be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.

trunk.主干翻译: 我与历史学家一样在夜里感到恐惧。

components.原文: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets

components.原文: whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets
components.中文翻译: 其日常工作围绕特藏与数字资产展开的
components.说明: whose引导定语从句修饰librarian

components.原文: I share the night terrors of historians, and I’d be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists
components.中文翻译: 我与历史学家一样夜不能寐，而且如果我说目前存在一套全面的保存方案，那我就是在撒谎

components.原文: if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists
components.中文翻译: 如果我说目前存在一套全面的保存方案

components.原文: a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists
components.中文翻译: 目前存在一套全面的保存方案
components.说明: said后省略that的宾语从句

sentences.zh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏与数字资产展开的图书馆员，我与历史学家一样夜不能寐；而且，如果我说当前已存在一套全面的保存方案，那我就是在撒谎。

sentences.zh: 图书馆员处于得天独厚的有利位置，能够理解终端用户是如何检索和使用信息的。

sentences.s: Thus we play an integral role in identifying, preserving, and providing accessibility to digital artifacts so that, while future researchers may find the digital realm a challenging place to ply their trade, they won't find it an impossible one.
